steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Muslims believe Allah sent prophets (rasul and nabi) to every nation to guide people to the truth. All prophets brought the same message: worship one God and live righteously. Muhammad is the final and greatest prophet — the "Seal of the Prophets" (Surah 33:40). | RS Exam Tips — Risalah: Prophethood: 1. For Risalah: Prophethood questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5.
